Oakley Haldeman
Oakley W. Haldeman( July 17, 1909- December 17, 1986) was an American songwriter(" Here Comes Santa Claus"), composer, author and the general manager for a music publisher. He joined ASCAP in 1949, and his other popular- song compositions include" Brush Those Tears From Your Eyes I Wish I Had Never Met Sunshine Tho' I TriedPretty MaryTexas PolkaHoney ChildVic'try TrainLast Mile", and" Texans Never Cry". Haldeman was born in California, the son of Catherine( Oakley) and Clarence Edward Haldeman.
